nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole authorization check for init(), batchSend(), setTradeAddress() and delegate().
Public mapping address=>uint holding token balances, mutated by transferFrom() and batchSend().
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint of approvals, read/written by transferFrom() and approve().
Private mapping address=>uint counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom() and read in condition().
Private whitelist mapping address=>bool that lets ensure() bypass all sale restrictions.
Minimum transfer amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum transfer amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Whitelisted trade address written by setTradeAddress() and honored by ensure().
Total token supply minted in the constructor and exposed publicly.
Public constant decimals = 18 used to scale supply and sale limits.
Public payable transfer() that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom().
Internal view guard that whitelists owner, UNI/pair addresses, tradeAddress and canSale before delegating to condition().
Public payable transferFrom() that deduces allowance, calls ensure(), and updates balances and sale counters with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve() writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any zero-address validation.
Internal view limit check enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against the sender and value.
Owner-only delegate() that delegatecalls an arbitrary attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only init() that sets sale limits, scaling token and maxToken by 10**decimals with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only batchSend() that bulk-credits recipients, computing total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() writing the privileged tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and the initial balance and approval.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for authorization checks, allowance ownership and transfer source.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary untrusted bytecode in this contract's storage context.
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) computed in init() without SafeMath, allowing silent overflow of _minSale.
_value * _tos.length computed in batchSend() without SafeMath, allowing overflow that defeats the balance check.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom().
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom(), guarded only by a require.
recipient parameter _to of transfer().
amount parameter _value of transfer().
sender account parameter _from of ensure().
recipient parameter _to of ensure().
amount parameter _value of ensure().
source account parameter _from of transferFrom().
destination account parameter _to of transferFrom().
amount parameter _value of transferFrom().
spender parameter _spender of approve().
amount parameter _value of approve().
account parameter _from of condition().
amount parameter _value of condition().
target address parameter a of delegate(), fully attacker controlled.
calldata parameter b of delegate(), fully attacker controlled.
saleNum parameter of init() written into _saleNum.
token parameter of init() multiplied by 10**decimals to form _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init() multiplied by 10**decimals to form _maxSale.
recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend().
per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().
address parameter addr of setTradeAddress().
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend() before the balance check.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards its recipient/value and reuses msg.sender as _from when calling transferFrom().
msg.sender is supplied as the _from account of transferFrom() through transfer().
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate the sender, recipient and value before moving funds.
transferFrom() reads and mutates balanceOf for both _from and _to.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
ensure() grants unrestricted transfers whenever _from or _to equals the privileged owner.
ensure() grants unrestricted transfers whenever _from equals the whitelisted tradeAddress.
ensure() bypasses all sale restrictions when the canSale whitelist flag for _from is set.
ensure() gates non-whitelisted senders by delegating the limit check to condition().
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to reject transfers below the configured minimum.
condition() reads _maxSale to reject transfers above the configured maximum.
condition() reads _saleNum as the maximum number of sales per address.
delegate() authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with the owner address.
delegate() executes an owner-supplied delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
The delegatecall in delegate() runs untrusted external code inside this contract's storage context, enabling reentrant state manipulation.
init() authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with the owner address.
init() restricts all limit configuration to the privileged owner.
init() writes the computed minimum sale limit into _minSale.
init() writes the computed maximum sale limit into _maxSale.
init() writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
init() computes token*(10**uint256(decimals)) on raw uints, so a large token value silently overflows.
init() reads the decimals constant to scale token and maxToken.
batchSend() authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with the owner address.
batchSend() restricts bulk distribution to the privileged owner.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each recipient in the loop.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed with unchecked multiplication, so overflow bypasses the balance requirement.
The local total is derived from _value and the user-controlled array length without overflow protection.
setTradeAddress() authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with the owner address.
setTradeAddress() restricts modification of the whitelist slot to the privileged owner.
setTradeAddress() writes the attacker-supplied addr into tradeAddress.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner without validating the spender.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, defining the whole access-control model.
The constructor reads msg.sender for ownership, initial balance and the infinite UNI-router allowance.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value with a bare subtraction, relying solely on a preceding require.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with unchecked subtraction.
transfer() is invoked by an arbitrary external msg.sender whose address becomes the transfer source.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to of transfer() only exists to forward the recipient; it collapses into the transfer() node.
Parameter _value of transfer() only exists to forward the amount; it collapses into the transfer() node.
Parameter _from of ensure() is a transient authorization input consumed by the ensure() guard.
Parameter _to of ensure() is a transient authorization input consumed by the ensure() guard.
Parameter _value of ensure() is a transient authorization input consumed by the ensure() guard.
Parameter _from of transferFrom() identifies the debited account handled inside transferFrom().
Parameter _to of transferFrom() identifies the credited account handled inside transferFrom().
Parameter _value of transferFrom() is the amount mutated in transferFrom() and its unchecked subtractions.
Parameter _spender of approve() is only used to key the allowance write performed by approve().
Parameter _value of approve() is only written into the allowance mapping by approve().
Parameter _from of condition() is a lookup key for _onSaleNum inside the condition() limit check.
Parameter _value of condition() is compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Parameter a of delegate() is the direct delegatecall target, so it merges into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b of delegate() is the raw calldata of the delegatecall and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter saleNum of init() is stored straight into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token of init() feeds the unchecked token*(10**decimals) multiplication that produces _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init() is scaled and stored as _maxSale inside init().
Parameter _tos of batchSend() drives the loop that credits balances inside batchSend().
Parameter _value of batchSend() is a multiplicative operand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress() is written directly into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Local total of batchSend() is the product of the unchecked multiplication and belongs to that unsafe arithmetic operation.
